Research Profile

I am a Ph.D. student at POSTECH working in human–computer interaction, with a focus on haptic perception and rendering for immersive experiences. I combine perceptual experiments, signal processing, and multimodal AI to understand how people interpret tactile cues and to turn audiovisual content into haptic feedback. My work spans real-time audiovisual-to-haptic systems, full-body vibrotactile rendering, and the relationship between physical contact dynamics and touch perception. I connect sensing, system development, and user studies to design and evaluate haptic experiences grounded in both physical measurements and human perception.
